Scrollbars hide while you read

PR #57 · 66a2ae7 · Ready for review, not deployed

The original rules showed the scrollbar while hovering anywhere in a pane, or while a mouse-clicked control kept focus. The fix fades it after scrolling stops, while keeping native scrollbar access and keyboard navigation.

Review round 4 fixes: 2 existing browser tests passed in 62.66 s. The tests compare actual stored scroll positions before dragging, establish idle before edge entry, and check checkbox keyboard focus alongside window exit, Escape, Settings resize, search focus, forced colors and reading positions. The checkbox regression remains covered; a new mouse-focused select check fails on the preceding head. Both browser tests also pass on the updated combined PR #57/#58 snapshot in 67.21 s. A real X11 pointer check verifies window exit without blur: the old build leaves the thumb painted; the fixed build hides it. No new test function or board fixture; no full-suite repeat. Actual macOS/Safari remains unverified: manual checklist. Native pointer evidence.
